**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW).**

Clause 28.1 selects Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts — outside the accepted list and an exclusive foreign venue, which is walk-away territory. It also conflicts directly with 28.2, which already grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County. No arbitration provision exists elsewhere in the document, and the 28.3 pre-suit escalation is acceptable.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): amend only the jurisdiction and forum words in 28.1 to New York law and New York County courts, reaching the preferred position and resolving the internal conflict, with Delaware/California/England and Wales offered as fallbacks in the comment.
